observations: SLES, SLS, xylene sulfonate and a secondary anionic cleanser form a strong cleanser system.
Dimethiconol, Dimethicone and cationic guar create substantial deposition.
Piroctone Olamine is present, but fragrance plus MCI/MI preservatives create sensitive-scalp caution.
